title: Goodbye language barriers
slide_intent: Give an inclusive promise a human gesture because welcoming language becomes more concrete when paired with a greeting.
strategic_value: A waving character beside the short promise can make Duolingo’s language mission feel social and approachable.
demonstration: White rounded text reading “goodbye language barriers” stands beside a waving, turbaned illustrated character on green.
practical_value: Pair a concise promise with a character action that reinforces its meaning.

content_islands.name: Message
content_islands.spec: Stack the white phrase at left in three lines.

content_islands.name: Greeting character
content_islands.spec: Place the waving illustrated figure at right, retaining the full body and raised hand.

reference_purposes.Expression: The short promise, green field and waving character express the identity together.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying agency account grounds the narrative in universal access to language learning.
